intro.text: You stand in the atrium. Two corridors lead away from here.

east.text: The research lab is cold and still. Monitors flicker. There is a door at the far end.

monitors.text: The monitors show camera feeds from every room — including one you do not recognise. You watch it for a long time.

west.text: Rows of shelves recede into darkness. Something has been disturbed here recently.

archive_search.text: Behind a loose panel you find a folded note. It reads: *You were never supposed to find this place.*

exit_good.text: You step outside into cold morning air. The building recedes behind you. Whatever you saw, it is already fading.

exit_bad.text: You leave with the note. Three days later, someone slips an identical one under your door.
